description: Native broad search-override child-continuation recovery audit. Start from the broad target-only fit and test whether broad distillation can retain enough continuation signal for a corrected native-32 search gate.

metadata.previous_result: native-searchaware-override-child-broad-targetonly-lr1e6-e160 fit the 690-row broad child-continuation corpus after export with exact .pt/.nn parity: 617/690 top1, 681/690 top3, sum gap 772cp, worst gap 64cp. It is non-playable because broad scalar drift stayed around 330cp.
metadata.diagnosis: The broad child-continuation target construction is learnable and export-stable. The remaining question is whether enough of that signal survives broad distillation to alter corrected native-32 search behavior.
metadata.targets: runs/native-searchaware-override-child-broadtargets-20260525/override_child_targets.jsonl: 690 child positions from all model_top1/search-overrode-model/reference-better cases, scored at 50k nodes per legal move and built with max_moves=16.
metadata.hypothesis: A single broad-distilled recovery from the target-only model may preserve a meaningful continuation signal while reducing the broad drift that makes target-only non-playable.
metadata.gate: Exported .pt/.nn model gate must retain at least 350/690 top1 on the broad child-continuation corpus. If it passes, run the corrected native-32 10k unified search gate before any deeper validation.
metadata.decision: Exactly one recovery audit. No preservation-weight sweep. No 300k gate or SPRT unless the corrected native-32 10k unified gate beats the original parent reference.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must retain at least 350/690 top1 on the broad override-child corpus with exact .pt/.nn parity.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Corrected native-32 10k unified search gate against the original parent reference CSV.
validation.hard_stop: No 300k gate and no SPRT unless the corrected native-32 10k gate beats the parent.
